correctness.rationale: Verified every essential inference by independent replay. Object S: 7x7 subdivision omitting {(2,3),(3,3),(3,4)}, retaining 46 squares; level-k kept-cell counts N=46/2116/97336 confirmed by rerun. Intact-row achievability: omitted block meets only y-rows 3 (x=2,3) and 4 (x=3), so rows with base-7 y-digits in {0,1,2,5,6} are fully kept; 5^k such rows, pairwise vertex-disjoint, each length 7^k. General-k construction valid by induction on IFS digits; rerun confirms counts 5/25/125 with full lengths 7/49/343. Maximality (Menger widths exactly 5^k for k=1,2,3): node-split Dinic reduction (vin->vout cap 1, source->A cap 1, B->sink cap 1, undirected edges as paired INF arcs) is the standard exact vertex-disjoint reduction; independent rerun of verify_emergent.py reproduces max-flows 5/25/125 (ALL CERTIFICATES OK). Modulus growth: for vertex p-modulus with disjoint paths of lengths L_i, Mod_p >= sum L_i^{1-p} via Holder (1 <= (sum rho)^p <= L_i^{p-1} sum rho^p); with uniform L_i=7^k gives M_k(p) >= 5^k*7^{k(1-p)} = g(p)^k. Correct for all p>1. Critical exponent: g(p)>1 iff p < 1+log5/log7, then M_k->infinity so lim is not 0, hence Q_LR=inf{p:lim M_k=0} >= 1+log5/log7. Certified edge: 5^100000>=7^82708 independently re-verified as big-int true, giving log5/log7>=0.82708 so Q_LR>=1.82708; sharpness 5^100000<7^82709 also verified. Transfer Q_full>=Q_LR: full/capacity family contains LR family, so Mod_full>=Mod_LR (admissible set shrinks), vanishing of full implies vanishing of LR, hence inf over full >= inf over LR. Direction correct. Identification dim_AR=Q_full cited to Carrasco-Piaggio/Keith-Laakso as stated in admitted topic; S is compact doubling uniformly perfect so hypotheses plausibly apply (residual risk noted, not a headline defect). Hausdorff upper bound: 46-square 1/7 IFS satisfies open set condition, so dim_H=log46/log7 standard; dim_AR<=dim_H standard; witness 46^100000<=7^196754 independently verified, giving <=1.96754. Combined interval [1.82708,1.96754] follows. DRAFT honestly scopes limits: maximality only k<=3 (not needed for growth bound), no exact Q_LR, no attainment decision, no full-modulus decay, LP enclosure excluded from headline, long decimals flagged as evaluations only.
